text: they want way to much for this app, and I would never get a subscription. the information is great, but that's it.
author: Cara Armstrong
developer_reply: Glad you enjoy the content! The app also offers a lifetime purchase – the free 14-day trial (ends automatically) lets you explore everything first. Pricing is fair, because there's much more: a complete ADHD-friendly organizer for tasks, routines & notes, extensive AI support, success journal, timers, reminders & more – all built for our ADHD brain

text: This app really needs a stopwatch! I had to download a separate app for a stopwatch. 🙄 This app is visually simple not too much color, bright notes, stars, Post-Its, general clutter to distract me from the tasks that are listed.
author: MJ
developer_reply: The stopwatch is already on the feature wishlist. I’ve taken your feedback into account.

text: I hate to put two stars because the app is wonderful in many ways but I cannot find a stopwatch. The timer is great but I need to know how much time certain activities take me so that I can plan activities accordingly.
author: ML J
developer_reply: Glad you find the app "wonderful in many ways" A stopwatch feature isn't part of the app concept - focus is on time estimation and planning with AI support rather than tracking. The visual timer also shows remaining time numerically when paused. If you'd like to discuss how to best use the app for your workflow reach me at rb@hyperfocus-academy.com

text: It doesn't tell you anything about the app until you enter and verify your email, and then it tells you to sign up for a subscription. So basically I've given them my private data for no reason.
author: Ashley Ward
developer_reply: There was a recent major update that added one-time purchases & family subscriptions and changed the selection options. In the process, I made an error in the order of items. I understand your point. The corresponding update has since been released and the issue has been fixed. Registration requires only an email address & a password – nothing else

text: really lovvve the app..but still not using..2 things needed: widgets(i wanna see today on my screen) and need a "lifetime payment option" not just monthly n yearly. i would defined pay n use if these 2 included
author: Palak PandyaModha
developer_reply: Thanks for your feedback! A lifetime purchase option will be available in the next few weeks. A widget is already on the roadmap — I just can’t give a date yet, as it’s technically quite complex. Hope you’ll give the app another try when it’s ready!
